considerations: Connections: Use one explicit owned association from the regional Web ACL to an existing modeled ALB in this project; no permissions are inferred.

Operations: Same project/account/Region modeled ALBs only. Verify regional availability, quotas, managed-group availability and traffic effects externally.
Security: Count mode does not block or replace application authorization, input validation or network controls. Request sampling and logging stay disabled; metrics are independent.
education.guidedExplanation: Create a regional ACL, start both rules in count mode and add an owned association to your existing ALB. Metrics are separate from request logs. Review traffic before changing enforcement.
